source.title: Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs (PMLP)

dos.title: Buy a Jūrmala entry pass if driving
dos.description: Entering the seaside resort town of Jūrmala by car between April and September requires a paid day pass (easily bought via Mobilly).

dos.title: Give an odd number of flowers
dos.description: When presenting flowers to a host, always give an odd number; even numbers of flowers are reserved strictly for funerals.

dos.title: Respect quiet hours
dos.description: Latvians value peaceful residential environments; avoid loud music or shouting late at night in apartment courtyards.

donts.title: Don't sit on the grass where signposted in parks
donts.description: Certain manicured flowerbed zones in central Riga parks prohibit walking on grass to maintain floral displays.

donts.title: Don't carry open alcohol containers on city streets
donts.description: Drinking alcohol in public parks, sidewalks, or transit is illegal in Riga and strictly fined by municipal police.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 5-10% is customary in sit-down restaurants in Riga when service is courteous.
